name: codexgpt-bridge

author: CodexGPT Bridge contributors

scripts.test:picker: pnpm build && node scripts/chatgpt-picker-e2e.mjs && node scripts/chatgpt-slider-contract-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:safety: pnpm build && node --test apps/desktop/dist/main/chatgpt-rate-limit.test.js packages/responses-gateway/dist/rate-limit.test.js && node scripts/chatgpt-safety-e2e.mjs && node scripts/chatgpt-auth-popup-e2e.mjs && node scripts/chatgpt-backend-recovery-e2e.mjs && node scripts/chatgpt-challenge-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:challenge: pnpm build && node scripts/chatgpt-page-session-e2e.mjs && node scripts/chatgpt-backend-recovery-e2e.mjs && node scripts/chatgpt-challenge-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:chrome-login: pnpm build && node scripts/chrome-manual-login-e2e.mjs && node scripts/desktop-chrome-e2e.mjs
scripts.package:win: node scripts/generate-release-channel.mjs --require-url && pnpm build && electron-builder --publish never --win nsis --x64 && node scripts/generate-release-manifest.mjs
scripts.package:win:local: pnpm build && electron-builder --publish never --win nsis --x64 && node scripts/generate-release-manifest.mjs
scripts.package:mac: node scripts/generate-release-channel.mjs --require-url && pnpm build && electron-builder --publish never --mac dmg zip --x64 --arm64
scripts.package:mac:x64: node scripts/generate-release-channel.mjs --require-url && pnpm build && electron-builder --publish never --mac dmg zip --x64
scripts.package:mac:arm64: node scripts/generate-release-channel.mjs --require-url && pnpm build && electron-builder --publish never --mac dmg zip --arm64
scripts.package:linux: node scripts/generate-release-channel.mjs --require-url && pnpm build && electron-builder --publish never --linux AppImage deb --x64 --arm64
